english.title: Fail to convey animals intended for immediate slaughter from border inspection post to slaughterhouse without delay

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 8(2) of Schedule 2 to and regulations 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies to elephants and to cattle, pigs, sheep, goats and all other animals of the taxa artiodactyla, and their crossbreeds
(ii) For an offence committed before 14/12/19 please see H18130
